decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation line extends the firm's established laser offer at low incremental cost, and its value is still uncertain after only one year with limited web visibility, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, drives recurring consumables revenue, has a page of its own, and costs little to keep while its market prospects resolve.

The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal model by covering other surfaces and applications, fits the strategy of matching technology to each application, and early results give no signal that would justify abandoning it.
